subject: Request: trial extension and promo credit — runtime adapter integration
messages:
From: Mike O'Neill <mike.oneill@bluelatch.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Sara Li <sara.li@bluelatch.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: trial window extension — runtime adapter integration

Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — BlueLatch's team is excited about Redwood, but we're hitting a blocker on our side that's going to delay the POC by a few weeks. Our runtime adapter (the one that slides between our event bus and the Redwood SDK) is failing on certain message batches and our infra team has put an emergency hold on further integration work while they investigate.

Concretely: the adapter throws an OOM inside our container when batches exceed ~8k tokens; we've attached the short error dump that shows the stack traces. Our lead engineer is out until next Tuesday, so realistically the earliest we can turn the adapter around is Oct 26 — about a 3-week slip. Given that, we wanted to ask if Redwood can:

- extend our trial sandbox window by 30 days, and
- provision a small promo credit (we estimated ~75k tokens) so we can continue limited eval traffic while we fix the adapter.

Our internal tracking: deal BL-4237. If you need more diagnostics I can loop in the engineer once they're back, but wanted to surface this asap.

Attachments: adapter_error_log.txt (snip)

Thanks,
Mike O'Neill
CTO, BlueLatch Systems
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Mike O'Neill <mike.oneill@bluelatch.com>, Sara Li <sara.li@bluelatch.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: trial window extension — runtime adapter integration

Hi Mike — thanks for the heads up and for sending the error snippet. Sorry to hear about the OOMs; that definitely slows a POC down.

We can absolutely support a 30-day trial extension and offer a promotional credit while you work through the adapter. Proposed short plan:

- Extend your sandbox expiration by 30 days (new expiry: 2026-11-20).
- Apply a one-time promo credit of 100,000 tokens to the account tied to BL-4237.

Before I apply the credit and the extension, I need two small things for our approvals:
1) Confirmation of the engineering ticket(s) or repro steps so our Solutions Engineer can reproduce locally (helps us advise on batching/kv-cache tuning).
2) A confirmation that you want the credit applied to the hosted sandbox (vs. a dedicated trial allocation) — hosted is faster but has throughput caps.

Ben (cc'd) — can you confirm this fits within the standard sandbox extension + promo policy (up to 100k tokens) or flag if we need leadership sign-off?

If you prefer, I can put together a short mutual action plan template so we keep timelines aligned while BlueLatch's engineer is out.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Sara Li <sara.li@bluelatch.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Mike O'Neill <mike.oneill@bluelatch.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 08:47:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: trial window extension — runtime adapter integration

Hi Laura,

Appreciate the quick reply and the proposed plan. We confirm the following:

- Engineering ticket: BL-INT-812 (container OOM when batch size >8k tokens). I've pasted the minimal repro below and attached the fuller adapter_error_log.txt and a schema export for the message payload.
- We'd like the credit applied to the hosted sandbox for now — we want to validate routing patterns before considering a Dedicated eval.

Repro (minimal): POST /events -> adapter converts to batched prompt -> Redwood SDK call -> container OOM. Steps and sample payload attached in schema_export_v2.xlsx.

If you can apply the 100k token promo and extend the sandbox expiry to 11/20, that should buy us enough runway to patch and revalidate. We can aim to reconvene the week of Oct 26 for a short re-demo.

Thanks — Sara
Sara Li
Head of Product, BlueLatch Systems
